An '''army''' was a formation of the [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]].

==Organization==
An [[Army/Legends|Army]] was commanded by a full [[General/Legends|General]]. The headquarters staff and support element of an army was larger than two full [[Battalion/Legends|battalions]] for a total of 1,855 men and twice as many [[Droid/Legends|droids]]. Overall, each army is composed of four [[Corps/Legends|corps]], and was considered the minimal unit needed for holding a key planetary system, and was also capable of capturing a system.<ref name="IHB">''[[Star Wars: Imperial Handbook: A Commander's Guide]]''</ref> It had five staff officers (SA1 to SA5) and ten sub-staff officers (SA11 through SA52), a security company (152 men) and six independent perimeter platoons (total 228 men), 200 [[Imperial Security Bureau/Legends|ISB]] agents for intelligence and counter-intelligence, three companies of [[Commission for the Preservation of the New Order/Legends|COMPNOR]] "observers" (each 152 men plus a command element of five for a total of 471), four [[Imperial Intelligence/Legends|Imperial Intelligence]] representatives and 784 support personnel.<ref name="ISB" />

An Army was composed of one of each type of Imperial Army [[Corps/Legends|Corps]] and was meant to fit into a naval [[troop squadron]]. That gave an army 193,644 troopers, 100,042 support personnel, 16,660 [[Repulsorcraft/Legends|repulsorcraft]] and at least 3,498 [[Tank/Legends|heavy tanks]]. [[Imperial Army/Legends#Augmentation|Augmented]] armies doubled the number of each corps type starting with line corps. While an Army rarely fought as a coordinated field unit, in the latter years of the Empire the increasing success of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebellion]] forced the Imperial Army to revive and redevelop this doctrine.<ref name="ISB" />
